items.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
items.summary: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.
